en.title: Business Incentives
en.subtitle: Unlock exceptional benefits for your business in the Subic Bay Freeport Zone
en.metaDescription: Explore tax holidays, duty-free imports, 100% foreign ownership, and other business incentives at Subic Bay Gateway Park.

items.title: Income Tax Holiday
items.description: Up to 6 years of exemption from corporate income tax for qualified enterprises.

items.title: Preferential Tax Rate
items.description: After the holiday period, a preferential 5% tax rate on gross income earned.

items.title: Tax Exemption
items.description: Exemption from local government taxes and fees for registered enterprises.

items.title: Duty-Free Importation
items.description: Tax and duty-free importation of capital equipment, raw materials, and supplies for registered enterprises.

items.title: Simplified Customs
items.description: Streamlined import and export procedures with minimal paperwork and faster processing times.

items.title: Foreign Ownership
items.description: Up to 100% foreign ownership allowed in most business activities.

items.title: Currency Controls
items.description: Free repatriation of profits and investments without currency restrictions.

items.title: Foreign Nationals
items.description: Flexible rules for employing foreign nationals in supervisory and technical roles.

cta.text: For a complete and detailed list of incentives, please contact our team.
